proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10299 mṛṣṭa/miṣṭa explicitly includes eastern miṭhā sweet and Marathi mīṭh, Konkani mīṭa salt. Hajong sweet and Khandesi salt therefore fit the same documented semantic family. Exact survey form miṭh is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
